statistical_unit: complete physical object or independent acquisition session

required_methods.bayesian_full_guarded: complete recursive Bayesian belief with registered guard and exact fallback
required_methods.bayesian_mean_guarded: Bayesian posterior mean with the frozen deployment-policy family
required_methods.last_residual_guarded: raw prediction identical to last_residual with registered guard and exact fallback

required_invariants: development calibration and target groups are disjoint
last_residual and last_residual_guarded raw predictions are identical
all arms use the same registered query horizon and statistical units
all rejected deployable arms use the exact physical fallback
proper scores are evaluated before target-informed method selection
frames points views and tracks are not independent statistical groups
required_outputs: tail regression risk coverage interval coverage and width
